subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Should WhatsApp sticker support initially transport only caller-supplied sticker-ready WebP, or should OpenClaw also convert arbitrary static and animated images into compliant stickers?
rationale: The two scopes require different dependencies, validation rules, failure behavior, performance costs, and public guarantees; source inspection cannot establish which product contract maintainers want.

options.title: Sticker-ready transport
options.body: Add an explicit sticker action or option that validates and sends caller-supplied sticker-ready WebP without promising image conversion.

options.title: Full conversion pipeline
options.body: Accept ordinary images and animated inputs, then encode compliant WebP plus required metadata before sending.

options.title: Keep unsupported
options.body: Leave sticker sending outside the supported WhatsApp action surface until conversion and metadata requirements have a clear owner.

recommendation.title: Sticker-ready transport
recommendation.body: Add an explicit sticker action or option that validates and sends caller-supplied sticker-ready WebP without promising image conversion.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has both recent history on the affected send/media paths and prior maintainer-side engagement on the issue.
